local Padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,8)
Padding.Parent = Scroll

--// PLAY EMOTE
local function PlayEmote(id)
    if CurrentTrack then
        pcall(function()
            CurrentTrack:Stop()
            CurrentTrack:Destroy()
        end)
        CurrentTrack = nil
    end

    Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not Humanoid then
        return
    end

    if Humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
        warn("R15 karakter gerekli.")
        return
    end

    local Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

    if not Animator then
        Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        Animator.Parent = Humanoid
    end

    local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    Animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)

    local success, track = pcall(function()
        return Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
    end)

    if success and track then
        CurrentTrack = track
        CurrentTrack.Looped = true
        CurrentTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        CurrentTrack:Play()
    end
end

    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 48)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42,42,52)

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    Corner.Parent = Button

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PlayEmote(emote.ID)
    end)

    -- Touch desteği
    Button.TouchTap:Connect(function()

    end)

        end
    end

    local query = string.lower(Search.Text)

    for _, emote in ipairs(Emotes) do
        if query == "" or string.find(string.lower(emote.Name), query, 1, true) then
            CreateEmoteButton(emote)
        end
    end

    task.wait()

    Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(
        0,
        0,
        0,
        Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10
    )
end

RefreshList()

Search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(RefreshList)

Stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

            CurrentTrack:Stop()
            CurrentTrack:Destroy()

end)

Stop.TouchTap:Connect(function()

        pcall(function()
            CurrentTrack:Stop()
            CurrentTrack:Destroy()
        end)
        CurrentTrack = nil
    end
end)

    Main.Visible = false
    OpenButton.Visible = true
end)

Close.TouchTap:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = false
    OpenButton.Visible = true
end)

OpenButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = true
    OpenButton.Visible = false
end)

OpenButton.TouchTap:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = true
    OpenButton.Visible = false
end)

--// DRAG SYSTEM
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

--// THEME BUTTON
local ThemeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ThemeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
ThemeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 8)
ThemeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Accent

local ThemeTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

ThemeTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

    {"🔵", Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255)},

    {"🩷", Color3.fromRGB(255,80,170)},

    {"⚪", Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)},
}

for i, data in ipairs(Themes) do
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    local row = math.floor((i-1)/4)

    Button.Size = UDim2.new(0,40,0,40)
    Button.Position = UDim2.new(0,10 + col*48,0,48 + row*48)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = data[2]
    Button.Text = data[1]
    Button.TextSize = 18
    Button.ZIndex = 21
    Button.Parent = ThemeMenu

    local C = Instance.new("UICorner")
    C.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)
    C.Parent = Button

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Accent = data[2]
        Stroke.Color = Accent
        ThemeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Accent
        OpenButton.BackgroundColor3 = Accent
        ThemeMenu.Visible = false
    end)
end

ThemeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ThemeMenu.Visible = not ThemeMenu.Visible
end)

ThemeButton.TouchTap:Connect(function()
    ThemeMenu.Visible = not ThemeMenu.Visible
end)

--// RESPAWN SUPPORT
Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    Character = char
    Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    CurrentTrack = nil

		local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

		startPos = mainWindow.Position
		
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainWindow.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.Width.Scale, startPos.Width.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Height.Scale, startPos.Height.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

		lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 40)

		lockBtn.Text = "🔓"
		lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
end)
-- LocalScript inside StarterPlayer -> StarterPlayerScripts (PART 2)
local bv, bg, renderConnection

local function stopFlying()
	_G.isFlying = false
	toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	
	if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect() end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() end
	
	character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function startFlying()
	character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	
	local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
	
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	bv.Parent = hrp
	
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp
	
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
		
		-- 1. Noclip Loop
		if _G.isNoclip then
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == true then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- 2. Thumbstick Logic (Horizontal Only)
		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		
		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z).Unit
			local flatRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
			flatRight = Vector3.new(flatRight.X, 0, flatRight.Z).Unit
			
			local localMoveDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDirection)
			flatVelocity = (flatLook * -localMoveDirection.Z) + (flatRight * localMoveDirection.X)
			
			if flatVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatVelocity = flatVelocity.Unit * _G.flySpeed
			end
		end
		
		-- 3. Button Logic (Vertical Only)
		local verticalVelocityY = _G.verticalDirection * _G.flySpeed
		
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(flatVelocity.X, verticalVelocityY, flatVelocity.Z)
		
		-- 4. Dynamic Tilt Engine (Faces camera look view)
		local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camLook)
	end)
end

-- BUTTON TRIGGERS & INPUT EVENT BINDINGS
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.isFlying = not _G.isFlying
	if _G.isFlying then
		toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
		startFlying()
	else
		stopFlying()
	end
end)

-- Noclip Activation Logic
noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
		if not _G.isFlying then
			_G.isFlying = true
			toggleBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
			toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
			startFlying()
		end
	else
		noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: OFF"
		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	end
end)

-- Mobile Hold Triggers (UP Button)
upBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		_G.verticalDirection = 1
	end

upBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _G.verticalDirection == 1 then _G.verticalDirection = 0 end
	end
end)

-- Mobile Hold Triggers (DOWN Button)
downBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		_G.verticalDirection = -1
	end
end)
downBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if _G.verticalDirection == -1 then _G.verticalDirection = 0 end
	end
end)

-- Dynamic Slider Drag Calculations
local function updateSpeed(input)
	local relativeX = input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
	local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
	sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
	_G.flySpeed = math.round(percentage * _G.maxSpeed)
	if _G.flySpeed < 5 then _G.flySpeed = 5 end
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. _G.flySpeed
end

local isDragging = false
sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isDragging = true
		updateSpeed(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		updateSpeed(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isDragging = false
	end
end)

        if notificationGui then
            notificationGui.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            notificationGui.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
        end
    end)
end

local function getExecutorName()
    if identifyexecutor then
        local name, version = identifyexecutor()
        return name or "Unknown", version
    elseif getexecutorname then
        return getexecutorname(), nil
    end
    return "Unknown", nil
end

local function isSupported()
    local hasHttp = typeof(game.HttpGet) == "function"
    local hasLoadstring = typeof(loadstring) == "function"
    local hasRequest = typeof(request) == "function" or (syn and typeof(syn.request) == "function")
    return hasHttp and hasLoadstring and hasRequest
end

local execName = getExecutorName()

if not isSupported() then
    Notify("CFrameFly", "Executor not supported!\nDetected: " .. execName, 5)
    return
end

Notify("CFrameFly", "Supported: " .. execName .. "\nLoading script...", 3)
